title: Nilpotent-free spaces of 3 by 3 matrices over the field with three elements — submission package

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
Nilpotent-free spaces of 3 by 3 matrices over the field with three elements. Hexagon/Overleaf and Linear Algebra and its Applications submission preparation, version 1.2.0. The reviewed folder Paper_2 package contains the article PDF, a minimal compilable TeX ZIP, AI provenance, Hexagon fields, journal details, an unsent cover letter with editable source, and an author-prepared AI disclosure. All PDFs have no row or margin line numbers. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.

The paper proves that the largest nilpotent-free subspace dimension in 3 by 3 matrices over the field with three elements is five. A direct algebraic construction gives the lower bound, while a finite reduction and independently checked search establish the upper bound and refute the proposed six-dimensional construction in this case.

Verification scope: The Lean development formalises the reduction and search soundness. Two compiled evaluations remain explicit parts of its trust base. This must not be described as an audit using only the three standard axioms.

Original preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00480v1. Earlier manuscript/source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23607867. Original attribution and component licences are preserved. Human-understanding and mixed-text declarations record the submitting author's explicit statement on 25 October 2026. The standalone AI declaration is author-prepared, not an official signed publisher form.
notes: Component licence notices in the original repository remain authoritative. The article is already available under the existing Hexagon CC BY 4.0 record. New package DOI is assigned by Zenodo after the GitHub release; no earlier DOI is reused as the new release DOI.
